subject: Accredita PO release / SKU binning clarification
messages:
From: Nina Park <nina.park@accredita.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Acquisitions <procurement@accredita.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup info + PO request (Accredita)

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. I attached the completed onboarding form and a CSV of the product SKUs we expect to purchase in the next 90 days. Two things we want to confirm before procurement issues a PO: an initial spend cap for the pilot and how you want line items grouped (we have 12 small SKUs that are usually billed as one consolidated line).

Specific asks: please confirm (1) temporary spend cap to be set on the initial PO, and (2) whether Redwood prefers consolidated SKU lines or individual SKU line items for accounting. We can reformat whichever way you need.

Appreciate your help — we want to be live by the end of next week.

Best,
Nina Park
Director, Procurement
Accredita Inc.

Attachments: accredita_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), po_line_items.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Nina Park <nina.park@accredita.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup info + PO request (Accredita)

Hi Nina —

Thanks for the materials, they came through fine. Quick answers:
- We can provision an initial provisional PO with a temporary spend cap of $60,000 for the pilot. That will allow you to start while final contract/terms are routed.
- For accounting simplicity we prefer consolidated line items for low-dollar SKUs (grouped as a single "SKU bundle" line), but we need a mapping in your CSV showing which SKUs are in each bundle so Finance can reconcile to GL codes.

Ben and Jordan, can you take point on the PO issuance and confirm if $60k is reasonable given the expected monthly run-rate in their CSV? If not, propose an alternate cap and any split we should create.

Nina — I’ll ask Procurement to issue the provisional PO once Ben confirms.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 08:14 AM Nina Park <nina.park@accredita.io> wrote:
> Hi Monica —
> 
> Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. I attached the completed onboarding form...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup info + PO request (Accredita)

Monica / Jordan —

Checked the CSV. Based on their forecasted quantities and our current unit rates, $60k covers about 6 weeks of pilot usage with a ~20% buffer. Two notes for Procurement:
1) If we issue one consolidated line called "Accredita SKU bundle - pilot", put a separate attachment mapping to the 12 SKUs for Finance reconciliation.
2) If they want individual lines, we should impose a spend floor per line (e.g., $1k) to avoid micro-lines that bloat the ledger.

Jordan — can you open the provisional PO ticket and attach the onboarding form and the SKU mapping? I'll mark it with a temporary spend cap of $60,000 pending security sign-off.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: po_line_items.csv

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Nina Park <nina.park@accredita.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup info + PO request (Accredita)

Hi Nina —

Thanks, I created ticket #PO-2147 in our procurement tracker and uploaded your onboarding form and the CSV. Ticket notes: provisional PO to be issued with spend cap $60,000, bundled line item strategy preferred, and include "SKU mapping" attachment for Finance.

Next steps for you: please confirm the SKU bundle name you want on the invoice (we defaulted to "Accredita Pilot Bundle") and ack that Finance will receive the mapping file for reconciliation.

On Wed, Jun 11, 2025 at 08:14 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:

> 
> Checked the CSV. Based on their forecasted quantities...

From: Nina Park <nina.park@accredita.io>

Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup info + PO request (Accredita)

Jordan / Monica —

Confirmed. "Accredita Pilot Bundle" works for the invoice. I attached an updated mapping file with bundle IDs and suggested GL hints. We also agreed internally that the $60k cap is fine for the pilot; we'll submit a formal contract signature next week which will replace the provisional PO.

We appreciate the fast turnaround. Please send the PO number when issued so we can route invoices properly.

Best,
Nina
Director, Procurement
Accredita Inc.

Attachment: po_line_items.csv (updated)
